statements.status_notes: The advisory fixes this in stream-json 3.5.0, but the Kubeflow Pipelines frontend server depends on minio, which imports stream-json 1.x internal module paths removed in 3.x. Bumping stream-json to 3.5.0 breaks server startup with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. minio upstream still depends on stream-json ^1.8.0.
